entries.author: xwbbb8
entries.title: 清冷东亚女子的极近脸部特写
entries.note: 9 秒竖屏，逐段写清眼神和转头动作。
entries.prompt:
生成一条时长严格为 9.00 秒的真人质感视频。9:16 竖屏，24 fps，共 216 帧，画幅以 720 × 1280 为基准。一镜到底拍摄一位容貌惊艳、气质清冷出尘的绝世东亚年轻女子的极近距离脸部特写。开场时鼻尖朝画面右侧，两眼都可见，靠镜头的眼睛在画面左边。全片的动作依次发生在眼珠、眼皮、头部和嘴角，幅度极轻柔克制。人物先看向镜头附近，继而把视线移向画面右侧，闭眼片刻，慢慢转成更侧的角度。她的目光由低处抬向右上方，随后脸转回，视线短暂落回镜头附近，最后在一次轻盈的眨眼和移目的余势里切断。
​开场构图与镜头
​镜头与人脸距离很近，视角大致在双眼高度。脸从左边压住画幅，头顶和近侧太阳穴被上沿、左沿截住，画面右侧有一道较窄的背景。把近侧虹膜放在距左缘约 15%、距顶缘约 24% 的位置，远侧虹膜约在横向 66%、纵向 27% 的位置。鼻尖处在画幅右半部，唇缝约在画面三分之二的高度，下巴底缘约在 88% 的高度。精致挺翘的鼻尖、柔和饱满的嘴唇与流畅纤细的下巴在画面上形成一条极具美感的由右向左回收的侧颜轮廓。下缘只容纳少量修长颈侧、柔顺深发和右下方一小片纤细肩部，让双眼、鼻翼与唇部占主要面积。
​保持固定机位和贴脸景别。转头时让脸在画框内自然偏移，鼻尖从右半部向右缘靠近，回转后再向画幅中部收回。左边界切到的位置随转头改变，侧得更深时画面能容纳更多近侧脸颊，回转时近眼的外缘重新靠近左边界。对焦落在眼睛和近侧颊面，近眼的纤长睫毛、澄澈虹膜和细腻肌理清楚，远眼略柔，鼻尖与嘴唇仍有足够细节。空间透视允许近侧眼睛稍大，远侧眼睛因夹角变窄。用连续的透视过渡呈现完美侧颜，眼眉鼻唇都随同一个头部转动。
​取约 5.75 秒的侧转和约 8.21 秒的回望作为两个取景参照。侧转时近眼移到画幅中部略偏右，画面左侧能看到流畅饱满的颧部和纤巧紧致的下颌线，鼻尖与右缘间只留一窄条空间。回望时两眼的连线略趋水平，近眼移回画幅左上部，眼尾有几帧靠近裁切线。让头部绕颈侧转过一个小角度，前后距离只有自然起伏，颈侧和肩在下缘给出轻微的相对位移。脸的大小主要随自然透视改变。
​背景上部是一块暗灰绿色墙面。画面约 65% 高度的水平分界以下是近黑色平面。墙面低对比，边缘轻虚，最明显的一段分界在鼻唇轮廓右侧。乌黑柔顺的长发跨在背景和脸部之间，给右边缘留出零碎的灰绿空隙。转头时这些空隙由人物遮挡而改变，固定背景始终维持同一位置和透视。保留参考画面简洁、高级的室内空间感。
​人物面貌与近摄细节
​用首帧锁定同一张倾国倾城的绝世容颜：三庭五眼比例近乎黄金分割，骨相立体优越、皮相细腻清透，自带电影女主角般的古典清冷感与松弛美。近侧眉毛如远山含黛，呈自然深灰黑色，毛流感清晰精致，眉头顺着眉骨轻柔向上，眉身匀称，眉尾纤细柔和地收拢，保留原生毛发的自然疏密。双眼生得极美，眼型修长微挑，眼尾自带柔和弧度；瞳仁深邃清亮呈浓褐色，瞳孔与虹膜边界清晰且富有层次，虹膜外圈深邃，眼神自带水光与故事感。上眼睑有精致窄薄的扇形折线，睫毛纤长浓密、根根分明且自带自然微翘弧度，单根睫毛有细小长度差。眼下卧蚕线条极轻柔自然，带一点清透的浅粉，内眼角精致微尖并保留健康的湿润光泽。眼白清澈微冷，毫无浑浊感。
​上睑褶皱在闭眼时逐渐展平，重开时重新优雅折起。下睑沿眼球弧度轻贴，刚闭上时两片眼睑之间留有一条纤细清晰的暗边。重睁的第一瞬先露出澄澈虹膜的下方，睑缘继续上升，直到自然停住。纤长睫毛从眼尾到眼头有优美的扇形方向差，合眼时如蝶翼般随上睑垂落，睁开时由睫毛根部带回原本的微翘弧度。几次较浅的眨眼保持短暂眼缝，清透的瞳光仍能从眼缝中隐约可见。
​鼻骨纤细笔直，山根过渡柔和自然，鼻梁有如玉般的细腻明暗过渡，鼻头小巧精致微翘，近侧鼻翼窄巧秀气，鼻孔为一小块自然深影。柔和的高光落在鼻头和鼻梁脊线上，跟随鼻子转动连续滑移。近侧脸颊向镜头展开时，靠近口角高度、偏脸颊外侧一颗极小巧精致的天然深色美人痣逐渐进入画面。痣固定在皮肤上的同一位置，随脸颊的转动进出裁切边缘，保留原来的大小和深浅。面中饱满平整，颧骨线条柔顺流畅，下颌线清晰纤瘦，下巴小巧微翘。下巴转动时带动下颌到修长颈侧的整条优雅轮廓，肩部只随姿态产生微弱响应。

entries.prompt:
【全局视觉、物理光效与合规总控】
9:16竖屏院线级高清3D半写实CG电影质感，虚幻5电影级光追渲染，变形镜头极低仰拍压迫感与奶油般浅景深，1/4黑柔滤镜柔光溢出、通透十字星芒逆光耀斑与自然胶片微粒，全程24fps电影帧率与真实物理运动模糊。全片严格单图锚定@图1人物容貌骨相、五官比例、发色、发型、巴洛克浮雕战甲服饰及标志性器物，发色自始至终绝对恒定不变；严禁转为2D扁平动画或实拍真人质感；全程依托实景建筑走位发力，杜绝脚踏虚空魔法。全片特效强制执行高阶物理光学管线：采用Emissive自发光三层亮度独立受控，内核高亮凝练、过渡层通透、外缘柔雾弥散且绝不污染主体与背景；元素运动严格契合对应物理特征；收招均触发Afterglow余辉滞留分层衰减，滞留微粒随自然气流缓慢飘散；高光折射仅作用于遗迹建筑、整体剪影、发丝轮廓、甲胄金属棱线与空气微粒，打造顶级CG过场大片般的厚重空气感与空间纵深。

【0.0s-10.0s｜单图绑定@图1｜金秋白殿·日轮弦斩】
[0.0s-2.0s] 28mm极低仰拍干脆起幅，精准对齐@图1日光琥珀波浪卷发、金枝桂冠、象牙白雕金高开衩长裙、半透明焦橙薄纱披风与巨型镂空金雕新月刃。正午烈日穿透巨型武器繁复的镂空巴洛克金雕，爆出一团璀璨耀眼的十字太阳星芒；她微抬精致下颌神情威严圣洁，战甲纤指凌空轻拨武器内部镂空弧框——十余根紧绷高亮的液态熔金光学琴弦瞬间凭空显形并高频震颤，严格遵循Emissive三层亮度独立受控，金白弦芯耀眼凝练且外缘柔雾丝毫不污染白石背景与秋叶层次。
[2.0s-4.0s] 镜头急速垂直后拉并侧向高速滑轨，节奏高能紧凑。她踏着洁白古典大理石神殿石阶优雅大步滑转转身，象牙白重磅高开衩长裙与半透明焦橙薄纱披风迎着暖风大幅翻卷，金色镂空笼状细跟靴踏阶轻脆稳健，自然勾勒修长挺拔的体态线条；她五指顺势大幅度凌厉横扫发光熔金琴弦，震耳欲聋的光学音波瞬间化作数圈层层向外扩散的透明黄金声波涟漪席卷整座神殿庭院，将满树纷飞的金秋红橙秋叶骤然震停悬空于璀璨日光空气之中。
[4.0s-6.0s] 机位压低切换至24mm广角强透视动态跟拍，空间纵深极致拉满。她双手发力高举巨型金雕新月刃凌空悍然斜劈，武器释放的炽烈日轮光能瞬间在洁白神殿巨柱后方急剧膨胀变形，投影化作一尊十米级高速自转的镂空巴洛克黄金日轮法阵；太阳热浪物理特征清晰显现，升腾热气剧烈扭曲湛蓝晴空与白石柱影，狂暴暖流裹挟着无数发光秋叶与炽金微粒擦着镜头前景边缘高速奔涌，画面富丽通透且色彩层次极其克制高级。
[6.0s-8.0s] 镜头低空高速向前俯冲推轨强化神性王者压迫感。伴随她手腕利落回旋收刃，高空巨型黄金日轮骤然解构分裂为三条宏伟交错的液态熔金光带，缠绕着古典白石廊柱与金秋枝叶盘旋冲霄；炽烈阳光穿透熔金光带激发出数道极度壮观的斜向金色丁达尔光柱，将她逆光飞舞的琥珀卷发外缘、象牙白裙摆与繁复金甲雕花照耀得璀璨夺目，白石地面流动着温暖清晰的金色焦散光斑与摇曳树影。
[8.0s-10.0s] 镜头平滑微推回极低仰拍中近景稳稳定格，焦点锁定高贵面部与金冠剪影。她从容优雅地将巨型金雕新月刃垂直轻点于白石台阶之上，武器内光学琴弦瞬间消隐，高空黄金日轮与熔金光带同步触发Afterglow余辉滞留状态，光纹由外至内分层衰减渐隐，化作漫天慢镜头细碎金箔星尘与失重飘零秋叶缓缓沉降；最终一道通透十字太阳星芒绽放于金雕刃锋，她沐浴金晖冷傲俯视镜头定格。音效：清越宏大的黄金竖琴扫弦重音，衔接音波震荡低频嗡鸣、烈风卷叶呼啸与金尘散落的空灵余韵。

entries.title: 紫雷长棍女战士的动作大片
entries.note: 作者注明在 Higgsfield 用 MAGI-2；需上传人物肖像作参考；视频只截取前 15 秒。
entries.prompt:
DURATION: Exactly 15 seconds
FORMAT: 16:9, 4K, 60fps
GENRE: Action blockbuster
VISUAL: Ultra-photorealistic live-action, ARRI Alexa 65, IMAX cinematic scale, anamorphic cinematography, physically realistic VFX.
CHARACTER REFERENCE LOCK — IMAGE 1
Use the uploaded female portrait as the absolute facial identity reference.
Transform the illustrated character into a believable real human actress while preserving her recognizable facial characteristics:
Identical face shape and facial proportions.
Same expressive almond-shaped eyes.
Same nose, lips and natural facial details.
Distinctive short black bob haircut with straight bangs.
Same hair length, silhouette and fringe.
Natural realistic skin texture, visible pores and subtle skin imperfections.
She is an adult woman with a fearless, confident expression.
WARDROBE: Black fitted tactical action jacket, black combat trousers, black boots and fingerless tactical gloves. Functional, elegant, athletic. No armor, no crown, no fantasy costume.
Her weapon is a long metallic staff infused with brilliant purple electrical energy.
Her face, hairstyle, body proportions and outfit must remain identical throughout the entire sequence.
ENVIRONMENT
A vast golden alpine grassland surrounded by autumn trees, natural rock formations and towering snow-covered mountains beneath dramatic golden-hour sunlight.
Fourteen identical-design hell monsters attack her. Charred black muscular bodies, enormous horns, dorsal spikes, glowing red eyes, molten-red cracks and massive claws.
ACTION SEQUENCE
0.0–3.0s — PURPLE LIGHTNING BLITZ
START MID-BATTLE!
Ground-level wide shot. Fourteen monstrous creatures charge toward the woman through the golden grass.
She instantly disappears in a violent purple lightning flash.
WHIP PAN!
She materializes between the monsters, spinning her staff through three consecutive devastating strikes: horizontal smash, diagonal reversal, overhead crushing blow.
Each impact launches monsters backward with realistic body momentum.
Purple lightning illuminates her face. Grass, dirt and rocks explode outward.
3.0–5.5s — TELEPORTATION COMBAT
Aggressive 180-degree camera orbit.
Three monsters attack simultaneously.
She teleports behind the first, dodges the second monster’s enormous claw, then leaps above the third.
Mid-air, she performs a powerful spinning staff strike.
Six translucent purple spectral staffs materialize around her, intercepting incoming monsters with synchronized strikes.
She lands in a low sliding stance, dragging her staff across the ground.
A semicircular purple energy shockwave blasts through the surrounding enemies.
5.5–8.0s — DIMENSIONAL RUPTURE
Extreme close-up of her determined eyes.
She drives her staff into the earth.
BOOM!
Purple electrical fractures spread across the ground. Rocks rise into the air. Grass bends outward under the pressure.
Twelve spectral staffs materialize in a rotating formation around her.
She pulls her weapon upward and swings horizontally.
A gigantic purple dimensional rift tears open across the battlefield.
Monsters are violently pulled into the rupture, disintegrating into black smoke and glowing particles.
Camera rapidly pushes toward the rift, then whip-pans back to her.
8.0–11.5s — TWELVE STAFF EXECUTION
A massive horned monster leaps directly toward her.
She instantly teleports through its attack, appearing behind its back.
Twelve spectral staffs orbit her at incredible speed.
She performs a rapid three-direction teleportation combo:
LEFT — horizontal lightning strike.
RIGHT — diagonal crushing strike.
ABOVE — devastating aerial downward strike.
Simultaneously, the spectral staffs fire concentrated purple lightning projectiles at the remaining monsters.
Multiple explosions illuminate the mountains.
She launches vertically into the sky, leaving a spiraling purple lightning trail.
11.5–15.0s — DIVINE THUNDER ANNIHILATION
EXTREME LOW-ANGLE SHOT!
All twelve spectral staffs merge into one colossal purple lightning staff above her.
She grabs the enormous weapon with both hands.
Purple electrical storms spiral around her body and the weapon.
She plunges vertically toward the battlefield at supernatural speed.
CAMERA FOLLOWS HER DESCENT!
At 13.2 seconds, the colossal staff SMASHES into the ground.
CATASTROPHIC PURPLE THUNDER EXPLOSION!
A gigantic circular shockwave tears through the golden grassland.
Rocks, earth and debris blast outward. Every remaining monster disintegrates into black smoke and glowing particles.
At 14.2 seconds, the camera rapidly pulls into an enormous aerial wide shot, revealing the expanding purple shockwave against the majestic snow-covered mountains.
At 14.8 seconds, purple lightning, dust and atmospheric debris engulf the frame.
END EXACTLY AT 15 SECONDS.
CINEMATOGRAPHY
Extremely kinetic Hollywood action cinematography.
Aggressive low-angle tracking shots.
Fast whip pans following teleportation.
Extreme close-up facial shots.
Rapid 180-degree orbital movements.
Dynamic aerial pursuit shots.
Crash zooms on weapon impacts.
Controlled speed ramps.
Dramatic perspective distortion.
Precise action-match cuts.
Every camera movement must follow the actual character movement. Maintain spatial continuity and readable choreography.
PHOTOREALISM
Ultra-photorealistic human actress, natural skin pores, realistic facial anatomy, physically accurate hair movement, realistic fabric simulation, natural body mechanics.
Hollywood-grade practical lighting, volumetric atmosphere, realistic destruction physics, physically grounded explosions, detailed environmental interactions.
Golden sunlight contrasts dramatically with electric purple lightning and molten-red monster details.
No anime aesthetics, no manga rendering, no illustration, no plastic CGI, no video-game appearance.
AUDIO & MUSIC
130 BPM orchestral-electronic fantasy action soundtrack.
Aggressive cinematic brass, powerful taiko percussion, rapid strings, deep sub-bass and escalating orchestral impacts.
Synchronized sound effects:
Electrical teleportation discharges.
Heavy metallic staff impacts.
Monster roars.
Explosive shockwaves.
Cracking earth.
Purple lightning thunder.
Massive final cinematic BRAAAM.
Music escalates continuously throughout the 15-second sequence and reaches maximum intensity at the final impact.
STRICT CONTINUITY & NEGATIVE
One female protagonist only.
Preserve the exact facial identity from IMAGE 1 in every shot.
Same bob haircut, same bangs, same facial proportions, same outfit.
No face morphing, no gender transformation, no duplicate protagonist, no extra limbs, no deformed hands, no weapon duplication outside the specified spectral staffs.
No random teleportation, no disconnected choreography, no frozen poses, no static camera.
No subtitles, typography, logos or watermarks.
ACTION PRIORITY: Immediate combat → supernatural teleportation → spectral weapons → dimensional rupture → twelve-staff combat → colossal thunderstaff impact → catastrophic shockwave.
END EXACTLY AT 15 SECONDS, 16:9.

Tiny golden sparks shed gently from its wingtips like drifting autumn leaves. Soft overhead studio softbox reflections shimmer along the curved glass panes in the blurred background, with crisp material fidelity, clean depth separation, and a hopeful, serene mood. 一、 全局风格前缀（用于保持画面质感统一）
